Harte’s Dental consists of two established dental practices with surgeries in Clonakilty and Innishannon. We are dedicated to serving the dental needs of adults and children of all ages. Our focus is always on treatment as well as prevention and education.
We offer a complete range of dental treatments to private, PRSI and medical card patients. Contact us today for more information and to make an appointment.

“You and your family will always receive a warm welcome, professional care and reassurance from our team. Patience with nervous patients is a priority. Wheelchair accessible and with easy parking, our bright and cheerful, state of the art surgeries will help make your visit to us a positive one.”
Harte’s Dental provides dental services for the whole family. Contact is at our Clonakilty Practice on 023 885 8536 or our Innishannon Practice on 021 477 5991 for more information.

Here at Harte’s Dental, we can give you the smile you have always wanted. Whether it’s teeth whitening, the replacing of missing teeth or orthodontic treatments, we can help you achieve that confident smile.

Periodontal treatment involves regular scaling and root planing to maintain the health of the gums and prevent gum disease. Gum disease can be divided into two classifications, gingivitis which involves only the soft tissue and bone. This treatment is frequently undertaken in conjunction with a specialist periodontist.

Often referred to as Root Canal Treatment this involves removal of the nerve tissue which is usually dead from the tooth and its root and the filling up of the resultant space. It is always done using local anaesthesia.

Irene is from Clonakilty and graduated as a dentist in 2011 from UCC. She then spent 7 years working in general practice in the UK, in Newcastle and Edinburgh, where she met her husband, Chris. Irene moved back to Cork in 2018.

Her favourite aspect of general practice is building up a relationship with the patients. She enjoys the challenge of managing nervous patients and getting them to a stage where they feel comfortable at the dentist. Irene is a member of the Irish Dental Association and is committed to keeping up to date with advancements in dental treatments and options.
When not at work, Irene enjoys going for walks, taking part in Clonakilty Macra na Feirme activities, and spending time with her husband, son and extended family.

Elaine is originally from Tipperary and graduated from UCC with a dental degree in 2005. After graduation, she moved to Edinburgh where she spent 15 years working in general practice treating a wide variety of patients and gaining valuable experience.
She moved back to Ireland with her family in 2020 and settled near Innishannon.

Elaine is a caring dentist and enjoys all aspects of family dentistry, particularly treating young patients and putting nervous patients at ease. She enjoys building rapport with her patients to help tailor treatment to their needs. Since graduation, Elaine was awarded the MFDS diploma in Edinburgh and she has continued to attend courses and seminars, to regularly update her skills and knowledge, as a member of the Irish Dental Association.
Elaine is married to Declan and has three young kids who keep her busy. She likes to keep active walking, cycling and playing football when she can.

Salina our hygienist, graduated in Dental Hygiene from University College Cork in 2013. Since then she has gained invaluable experience having worked in a leading specialist multidisciplinary practice in Dublin.

She is passionate about her work and educating patients about good oral hygiene. Salina provides treatments to her patients in a comfortable and caring environment where their care and well being are her main priorities. She believes in giving each patient the individual knowledge and tools they require to achieve and maintain a healthy mouth.
Continual professional development is important to her, she likes to attend lectures and courses to keep up to date with the latest advancements.
Salina is registered with the Irish Dental Council and also a member of the Irish Dental Hygienists Association.

Sinead is from Innishannon and has been working with Liam since 2006. Sinead works mainly in the Innishannon practice and attends the practice in Clonakilty one day a week. She works as a dental nurse but also works at the reception. Sinead is married to Damien and they have two children.

Margaret is a native of Rosscarbery and works as the dental nurse / receptionist in the Clonakilty practice. She has been working for Liam for the past 5 years and in her spare time enjoys walking, reading and spending time with her four adult children.

Catherine is a native of Tipperary and has been working for Liam since September 2021. Catherine works between the Innishannon and Clonakilty practice as a dental nurse and receptionist. She has a keen interest in sport and in her spare time enjoys supporting Tipp and Cork in the GAA.
